status_summary: No DOL investigation, enforcement action or rule directed at worker centers was found. The Office of Labor-Management Standards published a final rule on 2026-06-01, effective 2026-07-01, revising union annual financial report forms LM-2, LM-3 and LM-4; the phrase worker centers appears in that document only in a summary of public comments urging DOL to require worker centers to file disclosures, and the rule does not adopt such a requirement.
